text:
All tests pass and the issue's example now correctly raises `CycleError`.

**Root cause:** `order()` builds a `deps` dict that includes nodes appearing *only* as dependencies (e.g. `lib`, `util`, `log`), so `len(deps)` can exceed `len(graph)`. The cycle check `len(result) < len(graph)` therefore failed to trigger when the acyclic part of the graph contributed enough nodes to make the result length reach `len(graph)`, even though the cyclic nodes were missing from the result.

**Fix:** compare against `len(deps)` — the total number of nodes in the graph — so any node left out of the topological result (i.e. part of a cycle) is detected.
